facts: Parties: Kingsmere Energy plc (Company) and Oakhurst Bioscience Securities (Underwriter).
Recital C: the Company has 63,000,000 ordinary shares in issue.
Issuer: Kingsmere Energy plc. The date of this Prospectus is 23 April 2027.
Legal Proceedings: the Company is not party to any legal proceedings which may have a significant effect on its financial position.
Related Party Transactions: there are no related party transactions other than directors' service agreements.
Use of Proceeds: net proceeds of $120,000,000 will be applied as follows: repayment of the revolving facility $54,000,000; capital expenditure $36,000,000; general corporate purposes $35,000,000.
Capitalisation: 61,750,000 ordinary shares are in issue at the date of this Prospectus.
Item 3: the board discussed a class action filed by Elstree Robotics Ltd seeking $8,000,000 in damages. Counsel assesses the claim as having reasonable prospects.
Item 7: the board approved a loan of $4,000,000 from the Company to Idris Montague, a director, on interest-free terms.
